name: Yakimochi Imouto to Ecchi na Nichijou
original_name: やきもち妹とえっちな日常
source:
One day, you, as the older brother, you've got confessed from both of your little sisters. While living your daily life, you decided to get closer with both of them and choose one as your girlfriend.

However, when you get along with one sister, the other becomes jealous. What kind of conclusion awaits you?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01033266.html]DLsite[/url]]
